text:
aisha_csm: Heads-up — Velora onboarding is asking for SLO evidence ahead of renewal. They want confirmation on 99.9% uptime and p95 latency <=200ms for the hosted API. Can someone pull the 90-day extract and confirm credit exposure? @ravi_enablement @tom_cs_ops

tom_cs_ops: On it. Quick Q: do we measure per-route or rollup for this customer? contract wording sometimes ambiguous.

aisha_csm: Contract language: 99.9% uptime (monthly) and p95 200ms measured per-route on public API. Also notes warmup periods excluded. They hit an onboarding incident ~2 weeks ago.

priya_solutions: Dashboard link (internal): https://console.redwood.example/slo/velora — I can export route-level p95 + uptime CSV and attach tracing spans. Will pull last 90 days now.

ravi_enablement: We should include the enablement checklist we shared (warmup steps, cache recommendations). Helps narrative for renewal meeting.

sam_engineering: FYI the onboarding incident (INC-2024-227) was a routing misconfig in the dedicated pool; fallback rule didn't activate. Fixed fallback on 1717813600. I'll add the incident timeline + brief RCA snippet.

aisha_csm: :thumbsup: Also need a provisional credit calc if breach confirmed. Formula is monthly fee * credit_pct (per contract). Tom — can you pull the committed monthly fee?

tom_cs_ops: Monthly committed fee is $25,000 for Velora. Per schedule, single-month breach => 10% credit. I'll compute numbers once outage window confirmed.

incidents-bot: INC-2024-227 assigned to sam_engineering | status: resolved | duration: 4h12m | link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2024-227

priya_solutions: Export complete — evidence bundle uploaded: https://drive.redwood/velora-slo-evidence/1718604321 (files: route_p95_90d.csv, uptime_summary_90d.pdf, tracing_spans_90d.json). Note two short p95 spikes on 1717112000 and 1717720000; monthly p95 sits at ~185ms.

aisha_csm: Great. Ravi, can you craft a one-slide customer-facing summary explaining metrics, timeline, remediation, and credit calc? Need it for the renewal sync next Tue.

ravi_enablement: On it — will include timeline, credit math, and recommended mitigations. Draft by EOD tomorrow.

tom_cs_ops: Provisional credit if March breach: 10% * $25,000 = $2,500. I'll add a calc sheet and note aggregation rules if multiple months affected.

sam_engineering: Also include that we deployed runtime hotfix (gpt-kernel optimizer) on 1717800000 which reduced p95 by ~15% afterwards. Good to show remediation impact.

aisha_csm: Action items: Priya -> final exports + link, Tom -> credit calc sheet, Ravi -> customer slide, Sam -> RCA paragraph. I'll own outreach to Velora and share bundle by Monday COB. Please confirm here when done.

priya_solutions: Confirmed — exports uploaded and link shared above.

tom_cs_ops: Confirmed — calc sheet in the same drive folder.

ravi_enablement: Confirmed — slide draft ETA 2024-04-05 17:00 UTC.

sam_engineering: Confirmed — RCA paragraph added to the drive doc.

aisha_csm: Thanks team. /remind @ravi_enablement to post the slide in this thread tomorrow at 16:00. If anything else pops up I will ping.
